extracted.name: Braised Pork Ragu
extracted.description: This rich pork and tomato ragu is best when served over Parmesan risotto, but also tastes great over pasta, polenta, or potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds pork shoulder roast, cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Season pork with the rosemary, thyme, pepper, and salt. Heat oil in a large large Dutch over over medium-high heat. Sear pork in the hot oil until well browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Stir onion and carrot into pot; cook until onion is soft, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Pour in the wine; stir, scraping the bottom of the pot to release any browned bits from the bottom. Stir in the tomatoes and stock. Bring to a simmer; cook until meat is very tender and the sauce has thickened, about 30 minutes.
